title: Enterprise Account Executive - Developer Platform
description:
About the role
You will sell our developer platform to enterprise accounts in France. Our customers are engineering teams that use Python, Go, Kubernetes, Docker, PostgreSQL, Redis, FastAPI, Airflow and GitHub Actions every day, so you must be comfortable talking about Python, Kubernetes, Docker and PostgreSQL with CTOs.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of B2B SaaS sales, quota-carrying
- Track record of closing six-figure deals
- Pipeline generation, negotiation, Salesforce CRM
- Familiarity with Python, Kubernetes, Docker, Redis, PostgreSQL ecosystems is a plus

What we offer: OTE, equity, Paris office.
label: bad
